target.new_route_scope: Run one fresh public-post search for an attributable, current exact FM316 single-unit order or offer. Open at most one exact post returned by that query, and stop at decisive evidence or no-result.
acceptance_requirements: The post must identify Mondince FM316 specifically, not FM316-derived or FM336 products.
It must provide dated evidence of a current single-unit order or offer; a historical purchase, generic product promotion, or seller contact invitation is insufficient.
Keep author identity and private transaction details out of the repository. Record only a privacy-safe summary and public URL.
Treat a public seller claim as attributed seller evidence and a buyer report as community-report evidence; neither silently overrides contradictory official ordering terms.
Do not infer current mainland stock, price or package contents from identity alone.
